code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Clients branch on this, never on the message text.

details.description: Present for VALIDATION_FAILED as an array of field issues; otherwise handler-defined.

nextCursor.description: Absent or null when the page is the last one. A full page means there may be more; a short page is the end.

data.description: The handler's own payload. A handler that already returns an object carrying `success` is passed through unwrapped.

CursorParam.name: cursor
CursorParam.description: Keyset pagination for unbounded or high-churn lists. The cursor is the last id on the previous page.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Required on fenced commands. The first request executes and its response is stored; a completed retry replays it, a concurrent duplicate is rejected 409, and the same key with a different body is rejected 422.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Hard cap of 100 per page on every list endpoint, public included.

PageParam.name: page
PageParam.description: Offset pagination. Bounded administration lists only.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request or a failed Zod validation.

Conflict.description: A conflicting write, or a fenced command whose identical request is still in flight.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated inside the correct tenant but lacking the permission. A resource in another tenant returns 404, never 403.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist, or exists in another tenant.

TooManyRequests.description: The caller exceeded its rate-limit tier.

UnprocessableEntity.description: A reused Idempotency-Key sent with a different request body.
